description: Finite data for A -> Y; the final Thomason cofibration is sd^2 A -> sd^2 Y.

Y_order_definition.objects: X_i, S_j, tip; X is target_faces, S is source_faces
Y_order_definition.internal: X_i <= X_j iff target_faces[i] subset target_faces[j]; same for S
Y_order_definition.mixed: S_i <= X_j iff target_faces[alpha[i]] subset target_faces[j]; every S_i < tip
Y_order_definition.other: Only identities and the relations listed; no X-to-S, X-to-tip, tip-to-X or tip-to-S arrows

final_objects: Nonempty inclusion chains of nonempty chains of Y, with inclusion order; source restricts to base_face_poset_indices.
